task.title: Review a failed topic
task.shortdesc: The review queue lists topics the agent couldn't fix and rules waiting for a decision. Decide each one.

info.p: It shows what the checks found, the agent's summary and each attempted rule.

choices.choice: If a proposed rule is right, approve it. See .
If no rule is right, write one in the repository's rules folder and approve it there.
If the difference is acceptable, record why in the review and leave the topic for a writer to edit after migration.
